requirements.title: Description of each outsourced function
requirements.missing: The RoI lists ICT services, not outsourcings in the FINMA sense: flag which arrangements are outsourcings and add non-ICT outsourcings (e.g. cash handling, back office).

requirements.title: Service provider: name and domicile
Sub-providers of significant functions
Service recipient within the group
requirements.missing: Swiss group entities are outside the DORA scope: add them to B_01.02 for the group view and exclude them from the supervisory xBRL-CSV export.

requirements.title: Responsible person or unit in the bank
requirements.missing: Not part of the RoI. Maintain a business owner / responsible unit per arrangement.

requirements.title: Assessment whether the outsourced function is significant
requirements.missing: DORA 'critical or important function' and FINMA 'significant function' are similar but not identical: record the FINMA significance assessment separately where it differs.

requirements.title: Term of the outsourcing and notice periods
Due diligence before selection and ongoing monitoring of the provider
requirements.missing: Only the last audit date is in the RoI. Keep due-diligence and monitoring evidence (date, result, owner).

requirements.title: Security and confidentiality, incl. bank-client confidentiality
requirements.missing: Data sensitivity and the Art. 30(2)(c) clause cover security in general; document client identifying data (CID) and the bank-client confidentiality assessment for providers abroad.

requirements.title: Business continuity of outsourced significant functions
requirements.missing: RTO/RPO and the contract clause on tested contingency plans are covered; keep the provider's BCP test results.

requirements.title: Audit and information rights for the bank, its audit firm and FINMA
requirements.missing: The Art. 30(3)(e) clauses grant rights to the 'competent authority' (an EU authority): check that FINMA and the bank's audit firm are named explicitly.

requirements.title: Abroad: enforceable audit rights, restructuring/resolution, access to data from Switzerland
requirements.missing: Governing law and locations are in the RoI; document that information needed for restructuring or resolution remains accessible from Switzerland.

requirements.title: Written contract: sub-outsourcing conditions, termination, orderly transfer
requirements.missing: Covered by the Art. 30 checklist; FINMA may expect prior consent to sub-outsourcing of significant functions, which DORA does not require in every case.

requirements.title: Intra-group outsourcings identified
Inventory of critical functions
requirements.missing: FINMA critical functions (disruption endangers the bank or the functioning of the financial market) are not the same set as DORA critical or important functions: map them explicitly.

requirements.title: Tolerance for disruption per critical function
requirements.missing: The RTO approximates, but is not, a tolerance for disruption (which also covers data loss and service level): define tolerances per FINMA critical function.

requirements.title: Mapping of critical functions to resources, incl. third parties
requirements.missing: Third-party dependencies are mapped; add people, premises, internal IT and data.

requirements.title: ICT inventory with dependencies on third parties
requirements.missing: Covers ICT services bought from third parties, not the bank's own ICT assets.

requirements.title: Critical data: location and protection, also at third parties
requirements.missing: Storage location and sensitivity are reported per service; identify which data is critical in the FINMA sense.

requirements.title: Business impact analysis, recovery objectives and tested plans
requirements.missing: Keep the BIA and test evidence; the RoI only holds the resulting RTO/RPO and impact.

requirements.title: Incident management and reporting of cyber attacks to FINMA
requirements.missing: The incident log covers classification and DORA deadlines; FINMA reporting of cyber attacks follows its own guidance and time limits – track them separately.

requirements.title: Substitutability and exit for critical third-party dependencies
requirements.missing: Substitutability and exit plans are reported; test them in severe but plausible scenarios.

requirements.title: Scenario testing of operational resilience
requirements.missing: Not part of the RoI. Plan and document severe but plausible scenario tests per critical function.

requirements.title: Contractual security requirements for ICT providers
requirements.missing: Evidenced by the Art. 30 clauses on data security, security measures and training.
